reviews.review: Intense. You'd definitely enjoy it with friends. If anything it felt a bit short. The creature variation is alright. The final boss was a bit disappointing but I guess as you're just a marine and no Ripley, there might be some logic to it. Still feels disappointed with that nonetheless. The rest of the missions are alright with the card system keeping things interesting for replayability as you'd want to use them to get bonuses but at the expanse of some flaw. One even had a cam mode that makes it look like the movie with the dim color and flicker. Was kinda cool.

I would recommend this game, because its pretty fun, especially with friends (randoms is fine too).
However.
I had a few crashes when playing through the game, it didnt stop me. 
I finished the game but after.....
I can no longer finish a match because as the game loads some segments of the map, it crashes my game out into the desktop. this means i can't proceed any unlocks.
I have a very stable 60 FPS for the majority during most bigger combat segments i had 50 fps but loading map Chunks? naaah your game dies and I am not alone with this.

If anyone has solutions, please help me out so i can change my review to a positive one, and will edit the solution after this
Edit: i managed to get the game to a playable state by simply restarting the PC after each crash i can play a few matches like this.

ALIENS! SPACE MARINES! YES!
The detail and game play are terrific. Mowing down bugs is super satisfying. The story and character dialog are strong. Each play through is slightly different, and there's enough class leveling, challenges, and collectibles to keep it going for a while. Grab a buddy or two and start crackin'. Otherwise you can also rely on match-making, which hasn't disappointed me since it became available on gamepass and now cross-platform. I started playing when it first launched and I still come back to it. The updates and cross-platform have made it better than ever. Fans of the fictional universe can even nerd out on the details and back story.

9.5 out of 10. 
20 out of 10 if it had pvp squad modes with npc aliens/pathogen/robots randomly attacking! ;) ;)
Hghly recommend this game! Keeps you moving and is action packed!

The game is pretty good.
Rough at places, lacking in content and gameplay variety, and the DLC is totally not worth its asking price, but a pretty fun game nonetheless; especially at a current 50% discount.
quick play events are just there so we can all pretend they didnt make an 8 hour campaign. It only took that long because the matchmaking only works about half the time.
